To solve this problem, we can use the following formula:

$$
\text{part}=\text{percentage}\times \text{whole}
$$

In our case, the whole is $500,$ and the percentage is $7%.$ 

**Method 1**

First, we convert the percentage to a decimal:

$$
7%=7÷100=0.07
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =7%\times 500 \\  & =0.07\times 500 \\  & =35\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $7%$ of $500$ is $35.$

**Method 2**

First, we convert the percentage to a fraction:

$$
7%=\frac{7}{100}
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =7%\times 500 \\  & =\frac{7}{100}\times 500 \\  & =7\times \frac{500}{100} \\  & =7\times 5 \\  & =35\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $7%$ of $500$ is $35.$
